title: fix(app-shell): shell menu departures ask before dropping a page's unsaved edits (objectui#13231)
body:
Fixes #13231

Clause-②: yes

## What was broken

A settings page with unsaved edits asked before a link, its own crumb or a tab close took them (objectui#13163). The shell's own menus did not ask: they call `navigate()` from a menu button, and the page's guard only listened for link clicks. Help › All documentation, the avatar's Profile, My Organizations and Create organization, the workspace switcher's Manage members and Create organization, and a sidebar entry's ⋯ › Design each left at once, and the edit was lost. Picking another organization sent `set-active` first and then reloaded the document, so the organization had switched before anything could ask, and even the browser's leave prompt never appeared.

## What changed

- **New seam, `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`.** A page registers the edits it holds with `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(dirty, message)`, passing the question to ask. Registrations are counted. A shell departure that starts from a button goes through `confirmUnsavedLeave(go)`, which runs `go` at once when nothing is registered and otherwise only after `window.confirm(message)` answers OK. While anything is registered, the seam also installs one `beforeunload` listener and one capture-phase link listener (the same skips the two page guards used). It removes both when the last registration goes. It is a module store, not a context, for the reason `advertisedShortcuts` and `assistantBus` give: the pages and the header sit on different branches of the tree.
- **The shell's departures go through it.** In `AppHeader`: This app's docs, All documentation, Profile, My Organizations, Create organization, an app listed in the avatar menu, Log out, another app picked in the app switcher (wrapped where the header hands `onAppChange` to `AppSwitcher`), and the go-home shortcut. In `WorkspaceSwitcher`: Manage members, Create organization, and another organization. `handleSwitch` now asks **before** `switchOrganization`. On Cancel, no request is sent. In `SidebarItemMenu`: Design.
- **No second prompt after OK.** A `go` that returns a promise keeps the seam's `beforeunload` quiet until the promise settles. So after an OK, the organization switch's reload is not asked about again. A probe showed Chromium fires `beforeunload` synchronously inside the `location.href` assignment, so the flag covers it. Without the flag, the probe's control did show the prompt.
- **The two page guards register with it.** The settings hook `useUnsavedLeaveGuard` (console) is now a thin adapter: it registers and returns `confirmUnsavedLeave`. `SettingsView` is unchanged. `ResourceEditPage` drops its own two effects (`beforeunload` and the link listener) for one `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(isDirty, ...)` call with the question it always asked (`engine.edit.unsavedLeaveConfirm`). Registering it was a small move: about forty lines out, one in. One registry now answers whether the page holds unsaved edits.
- **Entry widening:** `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` and `confirmUnsavedLeave` are new exports on `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry, because the console's settings page must reach them. So the claim's `Clause-②: yes` holds.
- No new language-pack key. The settings page asks its existing `form.unsavedChanges`, and the metadata editor asks its existing sentence. The prompt is still `window.confirm`, as objectui#13163 ruled.
- `.changeset/13231-shell-leave-guard.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, patch.
- Docs (AGENTS.md #2): an "Unsaved edits" section in `packages/app-shell/README.md`, and "6. Unsaved Edits" under the key patterns of `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md`. Both say what the two exports guard and what they do not (browser Back and Forward, and departures not yet routed through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, such as the command palette).

## Measurements (dispatch hypotheses H1 to H4)

All browser readings are from the census driver, extended. It runs against the real console served by this worktree's Vite, with the API stubbed for an admin with two organizations, on `/apps/crm/system/settings/localization` with one unsaved edit, in Chromium 141.0.7390.37. The BEFORE leg ran at base `d4d9ddbec`, and the AFTER legs at `35cb4a28c`. Source has not changed since: the later commits edit only the changeset text and two docs pages.

- **H1, the producer: confirmed for the menus; the organization switch was a re-render, not an unmount.** A held `get-session` (the TIMED2 row) shows that 1.5 s after `set-active` answered, the input was still on screen but the "unsaved" bar was gone. Two `GET /api/settings/localization` requests fired right after `set-active`. The page stays mounted: its namespace load re-runs, which disarms its guard and resets the draft, all before the reload starts. That is why even the browser prompt was lost, and why the question has to be asked before `set-active`.
- **H2, the fix shape:** one seam (registry and confirm helper) that every shell departure in the surface goes through. Both page guards register with it, and `window.confirm` is kept.
- **H3, controls:** all hold, both in the browser (table below) and in the suites. The objectui#13163 suite passes unchanged on the seam: 12 tests, including the link, crumb, tab-close and every no-ask control. A clean page never asks. A page that does not register is unaffected (CONTROL cases in every new file).
- **H4, acceptance:** the pins go red with the fix reverted (ablation below).

| Departure from a dirty settings page | BEFORE (`d4d9ddbec`) | AFTER, Cancel | AFTER, OK |
|---|---|---|---|
| CONTROL sidebar link | asked, edit kept | asked, edit kept | n/a |
| CONTROL "All settings" crumb | asked, edit kept | asked, edit kept | n/a |
| CONTROL app switcher "All apps" | asked, edit kept | asked, edit kept | n/a |
| CONTROL full document load | browser prompt, edit kept | browser prompt, edit kept | n/a |
| Help › All documentation | no question, to `/docs`, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| avatar › Profile | no question, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | one question, to `profile_card` |
| avatar › My Organizations | no question, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| avatar › Create organization | no question, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| workspace › Manage members | no question, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| workspace › Create organization | no question, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| workspace › another organization | no question, `set-active` sent, reloaded to `/`, edit lost | asked, **no request sent**, stayed, edit kept | one question (no browser prompt), then `set-active`, reload to `/` |
| same, `set-active` held 3 s | no question, edit lost | asked, no request sent, edit kept | not run |
| sidebar ⋯ › Design | no question, to Studio, edit lost | asked, stayed, edit kept | one question, to the Studio surface |
| avatar › Log out | not run (bare `signOut()` in source) | asked, stayed, edit kept | one question, `sign-out` sent, to `/login` |
| go-home shortcut | not run (bare `navigate(homePath)` in source) | asked, stayed, edit kept | not run |
| RESIDUAL command palette › a page | not run | not run (driver selector error) | **no question, left, edit lost** (Acceptance notes) |

## Tests

New, 40 tests across five files:

- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/unsavedEdits-13231.test.tsx` (12): the seam's contract. It covers no registration, Cancel and OK, the last registration's question, counting, listener lifetime, the agreed-departure flag (pending, resolved, rejected, thrown), and the hook.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.unsavedEditsLeave-13231.test.tsx` (14): the real `AppHeader` with the real `WorkspaceSwitcher` inside it. Each menu entry asks; Cancel neither navigates nor calls `switchOrganization`. The question comes before `switchOrganization` (call order). OK reloads with no held `beforeunload`. Controls: nothing registered, nothing asked.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/SidebarItemMenu.designAsksUnsaved-13231.test.tsx` (3), on the real Radix menu and router.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.leaveGuard-13231.test.tsx` (5): the real page over a real `MetadataClient`. A dirty draft is registered with its own question, its link guard and tab-close guard still work through the seam, and a clean or unmounted page registers nothing.
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.shellLeave-13231.test.tsx` (6): the real `SettingsView`'s registration reaches the seam through the package entry, and comes and goes with save, Discard and a clean page.

Targeted run from the repo root under the shared verify lock, at head `35cb4a28c`. It covered every `AppHeader.*`, `WorkspaceSwitcher.*` and `SidebarItemMenu.*` suite, every `ResourceEditPage.*` suite, the seam's suite and `apps/console/src/pages/settings/`. Result: `Test Files 96 passed (96)`, `Tests 658 passed (658)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

**Ablation**, run after the fix was committed, under a trap that restores from `HEAD`. The five fix sites (`AppHeader.tsx`, `WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx`, `SidebarItemMenu.tsx`, `useUnsavedLeaveGuard.ts`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`) were checked out at `d4d9ddbec`. On disk, `confirmUnsavedLeave` hits went 5/4/2 to 0/0/0, `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` hits went 3 and 2 to 0 and 0, and the bare `navigate('/docs')` came back (1 hit). Result: `Tests 18 failed | 22 passed (40)`. The 18 that went red are every asks-first case. They include avatar › Profile, workspace › another organization (no `confirm`, and `switchOrganization` called on Cancel), the settings page's shell-departure and organization-switch cases, and the metadata page's shell-departure case. All 22 that stayed green are expected to: the 12 objectui#13163 tests (the old hook still guards links and tab close), every CONTROL, and the metadata page's link and tab-close cases (its old listeners). The direction is the predicted one. Restore was proved by blob hashes equal to `HEAD` for all five files and `git diff HEAD` at 0 lines.

## Gates (local, exit codes captured before any pipe)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0, 34 of 34 successful (8 cached), at `35cb4a28c`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` lists the four new app-shell test files (`tsc --showConfig`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0. Its program includes the new settings test (`tsc --showConfig`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, 0 errors. None of its warnings is on a new file or a changed line.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- At `23aca61e8`: `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` exit 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0 (1 changeset for 2 released packages), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` exit 0, and `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 13 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Docs patch `1040da80d` (the README and the console guide only): `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` exit 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0, `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` exit 0 (`Links are valid across 17 scan roots`).
- Every CI family is left to this PR's check-runs. The heavy gates above read `35cb4a28c`. The later commits edit only `.changeset/13231-shell-leave-guard.md` (`23aca61e8`) and the two docs pages (`1040da80d`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Residual, measured: the command palette.** Picking a page in the command palette (header Search, type "Accounts", Enter) left the dirty page with no question, and the edit was lost (AFTER, OK leg). `CommandPalette` hands `runCommand` a bare `navigate(...)` and is outside this card's file surface. It is the same family as the menu departures fixed here, and a one-line `confirmUnsavedLeave` wrap per call site once this seam lands. The same shape, read from source and not measured: `InboxPopover`'s `navigate` calls, `ConsoleLayout`'s AI entry, and the sidebar's own app switch through `onAppChange`. Reported to the seat as one family.
- **Residual, measured, a different mechanism: a language switch discards the edit in place.** Avatar › language › Chinese on the dirty page asked nothing. The page stayed, but the box went back to the stored value and the "unsaved" bar was gone. Read from source: `SettingsView`'s `load` is a `useCallback` keyed on `t` and is the dependency of the effect that loads the namespace, so a new `t` reloads the payload and resets the draft. That is also the re-run seen after `set-active` in H1. This is not a departure, so it is outside this card. Reported to the seat.
- **Not registered, read from source:** `StudioDesignSurface` and `PermissionMatrixEditor` keep their own leave guards and do not register with the seam, so a shell menu leaves those pages without their question. Carrier: none.
- **Still out of reach:** browser Back and Forward (`popstate`), as in objectui#13163. Carrier: none.
- The two new exports are documented in `packages/app-shell/README.md` and the console architecture guide (`1040da80d`), added after the seat amended the claim's file surface to include them.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
